Hello, world

This is the first note from the WuBu desk of the CEO. A long time goal has been to publish an application to the App Store. We are finally pursuing our goal.

What's in a name?

WuBu? This is a play on our names and a fun obsession with Bubu and Dudu, WuBu, LLC. Our plan is to create useful and fun apps.

What's the plan with our blog?

We want to share progress, ideas, UX, and the challenges with developing the apps. These are our first apps and quite sure it will be a road filled with learning.

There is a section we call Fun. Experimental might be a better term. Simple online apps created with AI.

More coming soon. We have day jobs so updates might be slow but there will be updates!

Enjoy creating your own fun projects.
